title: Agent-core apply_commit_op: refuse two room_metadata updates in one Commit (protocol-07 §7.6), as the hub now does
description: mimid-nfze (5815630) made the hub refuse a Commit with two room_metadata updates (ComponentError::RepeatedUpdate). mimid-agent-core's components.rs has its own apply_commit_op copy without that check. Better: share one implementation.
